Text: WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request at the planned peak load, the loyalty service shall return the validation result within TBD ms for 95% of requests.
Rationale: "Checkout must not get slower" (SH-02); voucher validation is a new call in the checkout path; target is open question Q1.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service records a points transaction, the customer mobile app shall show the transaction in the member's points history within TBD seconds.
Rationale: "Show the new balance quickly" (SH-01); target is open question Q2.

Text: The loyalty service shall accept TBD purchase events per minute for TBD minutes without losing an event.
Rationale: "Must survive the year-end sale peak" (SH-08); last year's peak was 9,000 purchases per minute; planned peak is open question Q3.

Text: The loyalty service shall be available for earn events and voucher validation for TBD % of store trading hours in each calendar month.
Rationale: Reliability concern from the walkthrough; target and trading hours are open question Q4.

Text: IF the fraud engine is unavailable, THEN the loyalty service shall keep accepting earn events from the POS.
Rationale: "If the fraud engine is down, earning must carry on; we score later" (SH-05); outage length is open question Q5.

Text: IF the loyalty service stops processing because of a failure, THEN the loyalty service shall resume processing within TBD minutes without losing a recorded points transaction.
Rationale: Finance reconciles every transaction (SH-08); recovery time is open question Q6.

Text: The loyalty service shall reject API requests from the POS and the customer mobile app that do not carry valid client credentials.
Rationale: "Every call from the tills and the app must be authenticated" (SH-05).

Text: The loyalty service shall encrypt member personal data in transit on its interfaces with the POS, the customer mobile app, the CRM, the fraud engine, the notification provider and the data warehouse.
Rationale: "Member data is encrypted on the wire, to all of our systems" (SH-05); protocol version is open question Q7.

Text: The loyalty service shall prevent support console agents from changing or deleting points adjustment records.
Rationale: Quality part of "auditable" (SH-03): nobody can edit an adjustment record afterwards.

Text: The loyalty service shall let the marketing team set up a bonus campaign that uses an existing multiplier rule without a software release.
Rationale: Marketing runs a campaign almost every month and each needs a release today; lead time is open question Q8.
